verdict.rationale: Granola exposes meeting notes and AI summaries through a REST API and an official MCP server, so an agent can read each meeting's content. Its Zapier integration connects to 8,000+ apps to "automate what happens after a meeting," which gives a plausible path into Linear, Jira or Asana. However, filing tasks into a tracker requires stitching together external tools, and native post-meeting workflows only cover email, Slack and Calendar. Missing for 10: native Linear/Jira/Asana integrations, documented webhooks or meeting-completed triggers, explicit action-item extraction to trackers, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end tracker flow.
